name: generate_meme
description: Generate a meme image based on a search prompt and variable number of text lines (top, middle, bottom, etc.). Can optionally send to Slack.

prompt.description: Keyword to find a meme template (e.g., 'doge', 'captain', 'coding').

texts.description: Array of text lines to place on the meme. Order matters (Top -> Bottom). For Captain meme, use 3 lines.

sendToSlack.description: Whether to send the generated meme to the configured Slack channel.
